atomicFlashApplicability.conclusion: No live KLend reserve or Project0/marginfi bank exists for any of the five relevant mints. Both community mints have zero supply. All 8 target-realm council units and all 7 upgrade-controller council units are already in their respective realm holdings, accounting for 100% of each positive membership supply; therefore no AMM or additional flash provider can hold positive exact-mint inventory for a swap or loan. PHY is not a governing token. Unrelated flash capital cannot create a PDA, council, or fixed external signature.
atomicFlashApplicability.exactAvailableAndBoundaryTests: not constructible: there is no reserve, bank, pool inventory, or other positive external token balance for either governing mint, so no provider account exists at which to test available-1/exact/available+1
atomicFlashApplicability.triOrMaximumSourceCombination: not constructible and cannot affect these authorization-gated actions; provider count for the required governing asset is zero
atomicFlashApplicability.reasonNotTested: No relevant same-mint lender route or governing-token route exists; fabricating a provider or wrapping the action with unrelated USDC/wSOL would not test an immediate live outsider path.
